text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Yeah. This is the closest I've ever gotten to you…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I can feel the breeze left in your wake now… Just barely, but… much more than before…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: And I think… I know who I have to thank for that…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I… We are going to train even harder.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: So wait for me there… across the gloom…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Because I'm going to catch up to you. I know it.
